payload.title: Submit mutation creates a public pending record immediately
payload.description:
As a signed-in reader, I want my submitted link to appear publicly right away, so that submitting feels immediate.

Notes: creates a pending reference record with provenance (submitter handle, time, canonical URL) and returns immediately. The pending record is visible to everyone (public immediately). How pending items are rendered (a JSON record shown by one client-side item shell versus a static page generated on promotion) is an implementer decision; record the choice and its effect on feeds, search and agent-readable twins on this story. Optional pre-moderation (hold until approved) is a publication setting owned by the moderation epic.

```gherkin
Feature: Submit a link
  Scenario: Submit
    Given a signed-in reader on a publication with submissions enabled
    When the reader submits a URL, a title (at most 90 characters), a type and a note
    Then a pending submission exists with the reader's handle and the canonical URL
    And it is visible publicly without waiting for extraction or review
    And the response returns without waiting for extraction

  Scenario: Guest cannot submit
    When a guest calls the submit mutation
    Then it is rejected

  Scenario: Invalid input
    When the title exceeds 90 characters or the URL is not http or https
    Then the submission is rejected with a clear message
```
